messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Product & Ops weekly sync — action rollup + exec asks for QBR

Thanks team — quick rollup from today’s cross-functional sync and a short list of exec asks I need by EOD Friday so we can finalize the QBR packet. I’ve attached the working action tracker and a short QBR digest. Please reply inline with status updates where noted.

High-level asks (owners + target):
1) Dashboard changes for SLA visibility — owner: Laura B. — due: 2027-05-06
   - Need final mock + data query (token-latency per model, per-route). See attachment: dashboard-mock.png
2) Roadmap commitment for model-pinning and autoscale gating — owner: Rishi M. — due: 2027-05-03
   - We need a firm ship milestone to present to the execs (must include rollout phases and SLOs).
3) Contract / procurement exceptions for Dedicated trials with Acme — owner: Marissa C. — due: 2027-05-04
   - Acme’s procurement requested a 60-day trial with throughput SLAs; legal will likely need to sign off on limited liability exception.
4) Budget ask for capacity trials (outline + justification) — owner: Marcus L. (cc’d) — due: 2027-05-05

Immediate blockers / open questions:
- Does Product commit to one PIN approach (model pinning) vs. phased feature flags? If phased, we need an explicit fallthrough policy to present.
- What’s the expected token-level cost delta when we enable caching for priority tenants (rough order of magnitude)?

Please update the tracker (action_tracker_20270425.xlsx) with short status bullets. If you need me to escalate any of these as an exec ask (I’ll raise in tomorrow’s leadership prep), flag it with the tag [EXEC].

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Program Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: action_tracker_20270425.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR-digest-2027Q2.pdf (summary)

Thanks — quick status update on dashboard work:
- Mock: uploaded a high-fidelity mock to the QBR Drive folder (link below). See: dashboard-mock.png attached.
- Data contract: I’ve sketched the token/latency query (example SQL) — will need a short ETL window to surface per-route token metrics; engineering estimate is ~6 dev-days to wire into the dashboard behind feature flag.
- UX ask: show both 99th and p95 latency slices for the last 30 days; add an ability to filter by dedicated vs hosted.

Open ask for Eng/Product: Do we want separate panels for model-variant rollout (quant vs fp16) or one unified view? My recommendation is unified with variant toggles so execs see overall impact without clicking through.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Product & Ops weekly sync — action rollup + exec asks for QBR

Fwd: short roadmap note + timeline

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 14:12, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update on model-pinning and autoscale gating: after the arch review we have two viable approaches:
>  - Option A (fast): soft-pin per-tenant routing + autoscale guardrails; can ship limited rollout by 2027-05-19 (can meet initial SLA for latency but will require manual fallbacks).
>  - Option B (robust): kernel-level pinning + automated fallback + canary rollback support; ETA 2027-06-30.
>
> Risks: Option A increases operational load for support and could surface cost regressions without automatic throttles. Option B needs more infra work but gives predictable ops overhead and is preferable for enterprise SLAs.
>
> For the QBR, I propose we present both options and ask execs to approve a phased commit: allow Option A as a limited pilot for Acme with a clear sunset to Option B.
>
> Flags: we will need an SLA exception for the pilot (60-day trial) — tagging legal/procurement.
>
> Rishi

I’ll update the action tracker with the two-scenario language and milestones. If we want to position this as an exec ask we should include the support cost delta (est. +8–12% infra spend for the pilot) and a success metric (p99 within 200ms for priority routes).
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

1) Approve phased rollout for model-pinning (Option A pilot w/ sunset to Option B).
   - Owner: Rishi M.
   - Ask: Approve pilot with 60-day trial for Acme (legal exceptions noted).
2) Approve up to 12% incremental budget for Dedicated capacity trials for priority tenants (justification attached).
   - Owner: Marcus L.
3) Approve additional 30-day retention for SLA logs for enterprise trials (compliance coverage).
   - Owner: Marissa C. / Legal (I’ll loop legal if we get approval).
